basic_info.description: *New Price* Charming top-floor Edwardian in San Francisco's highly sought-after North of Lake neighborhood. This beautifully maintained three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath residence, built in 1925, effortlessly blends historic elegance with modern updates. Located on a rare, quiet street where kids still play outside, it offers a serene retreat just steps from the Presidio, Mountain Lake Park, and the vibrant dining and shopping scene of Clement Street.  Inside, you'll find classic Edwardian features like coved ceilings, original hardwood floors, and beautiful millwork. Windows everywhere bring abundant natural light throughout - the living room is highlighted by a signature bay window and a classically detailed fireplace, while the formal dining room showcases intricate wall moldings. The bright, updated eat-in kitchen features new countertops and stainless steel appliances. An expansive sunroom adds versatile living space, ideal as a home office or nursery. Additional perks include in-unit laundry, a sun-filled shared garden, and two-car tandem parking with extra storage. With a Walk Score of 92 and a Transit Score of 80, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and City convenience. Fire in fireplace photos is virtual.
